limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance, never real-cohort, causal, physical or clinical validation.
The unadjusted two-group right-censored reference excludes covariates, delayed entry, competing events and interval censoring; the event minimum is not a power justification.
Censoring fraction balance cannot prove noninformative censoring. The O/E ratio is exploratory, never a Cox estimate or a proportional-hazards claim.
Hash-bound declarations cannot independently establish historical freeze timing or true source independence; independent review remains coordinator-owned and unavailable here.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. The gate also refuses truth, physical validity and patient benefit, includes negations and is incomplete for unlisted paraphrases.
Missing or unavailable cited records require unavailable claims, never negative evidence; computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims.
Replication requires distinct cited source paths and hashes with declared non-internal evidence passing anti-alias checks; this is not proof of real-world independence.
Raw artifacts are bounded to 64 MiB each and 256 MiB per bundle across distinct inodes; hardlink aliases share the aggregate budget.
